description: Create all TanStack Query data hooks in src/hooks/ to wire Supabase to the frontend. Create src/services/php.ts as the PHP API client. Update the AI service providers.ts to call the Supabase Edge Function. Create the Supabase Edge Function at supabase/functions/ai-chat/index.ts.
steps: Create src/hooks/useProducts.ts - CRUD operations on products table using TanStack Query (useQuery for list with pagination/filters, useMutation for create/update/delete, optimistic updates on mutations). Query keys: ['products'], ['products', id]. Supabase queries on 'products' table.
Create src/hooks/useWarehouses.ts - warehouse CRUD + stock summary. Joins with inventory table to get total quantity per warehouse.
Create src/hooks/useStockMovements.ts - fetch stock_movements with date/type/warehouse filters, create new movements. Supports pagination.
Create src/hooks/useCustomers.ts - CRUD on customers table. Search by company_name, filter by customer_type. Pagination.
Create src/hooks/useLeads.ts - lead CRUD, status transitions (update status field). Filter by status, source, assigned_to.
Create src/hooks/useDeals.ts - deal CRUD, stage progression. Filter by stage, assigned_to. Include value aggregations.
Create src/hooks/useSuppliers.ts - supplier CRUD with rating filter.
Create src/hooks/usePurchaseOrders.ts - PO CRUD with line items (purchase_order_items). Status workflow transitions. Joins with supplier for display.
Create src/hooks/useSalesOrders.ts - SO CRUD with line items (sales_order_items). Status workflow. Joins with customer.
Create src/hooks/useActivities.ts - activities CRUD. Filter by type, related entity, assigned_to.
Create src/hooks/useNotifications.ts - fetch notifications for current user, mark as read, real-time subscription via Supabase Realtime channel.
Create src/hooks/useAuditLog.ts - fetch audit_logs with filters (user, entity_type, action, date range). Read-only, paginated.

Create src/hooks/useDashboard.ts - aggregate KPIs: total products count, low stock count (inventory.quantity < products.min_stock_level), active deals value sum, monthly revenue from sales_orders, pending orders count.
Create src/hooks/useProfile.ts - fetch current user profile from profiles table, update profile.

Create src/services/php.ts - PHP API client class that forwards Supabase JWT in Authorization header. Methods: generateInvoice, generatePO, generateStockReport, sendEmail, sendWhatsApp, importExcel, exportInventory. Base URL from VITE_PHP_API_URL env var.

Update src/services/ai/providers.ts - modify ProxyProvider to call the Supabase Edge Function URL (constructed from VITE_SUPABASE_URL + '/functions/v1/ai-chat'). Include the user's access token in Authorization header. Send agentType and conversationId in the request body.

Create supabase/functions/ai-chat/index.ts - Deno runtime edge function. Accept POST with { message, agentType, conversationId? }. Validate JWT from Authorization header. Route to OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic based on AI_PRIMARY_PROVIDER env var. Use agent system prompts. Save conversation to ai_conversations table via Supabase client. Return JSON response.

Ensure all hooks use proper TypeScript types from src/types/database.ts. Note that DB schema column names differ slightly from TS types (e.g., company_name in DB = name in TS type for Customer). The hooks should work with the actual DB column names and map to the frontend types.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 hook files exist in src/hooks/ with proper TanStack Query patterns
Each hook exports query hooks (useQuery) and mutation hooks (useMutation)
All hooks include pagination support via page/pageSize parameters
src/services/php.ts exists with all required methods and JWT forwarding
src/services/ai/providers.ts ProxyProvider calls Supabase Edge Function URL
supabase/functions/ai-chat/index.ts exists with Deno runtime code
pnpm type-check passes with zero errors
verification: Run 'pnpm type-check' and confirm zero errors
Verify supabase/functions/ai-chat/index.ts contains JWT validation, provider routing, and conversation storage logic
